name: The Conquered
description:
The tip of its spear has drawn a boundless border.
The people and soldiers within the border are marked as conquered, or ones to be conquered.
The blood of the fearful will become honey for the divine body, and the souls of the defiant will walk into the palace of glory under the River of Souls.

skills.name: Victor Upon Billions of Bones
skills.description: "The Conquered" cannot take action. When summoned, it gains <u>"War Armor"</u> or <u>"Centirefined War Armor"</u> based on the phase of "The Ravaged Unconquerable."

skills.name: A Home After Countless Scars
skills.description: When "The Conquered" receives a killing blow, if <u>"War Armor"</u> or <u>"Centirefined War Armor"</u> is not yet destroyed, directly gains corresponding Skill Points and <u>"Glory"</u> rewards. When receiving a killing blow, reduces the Toughness and HP of "The Ravaged Unconquerable".
